name: Mojave D&D Bot
description: Complete D&D companion with dice rolling, initiative tracking, and status effects. Features auto-save persistence, connection keepalive, and comprehensive D&D 5e condition support.
author: Root Community

commands.name: help
commands.description: Show help menu with command categories

commands.name: roll
commands.description: Roll dice with modifiers and special features

commands.name: adv
commands.description: Roll with advantage (2d20 keep highest)

commands.name: dis
commands.description: Roll with disadvantage (2d20 keep lowest)

commands.name: rr
commands.description: Roll the same dice expression multiple times

commands.name: stats
commands.description: Generate 6 D&D ability scores (4d6 keep highest 3)

commands.name: threshold
commands.description: Generate D&D threshold stats (reroll 1s/2s, drop lowest)

commands.name: init
commands.description: Display initiative tracker

commands.name: init add
commands.description: Add combatant to initiative

commands.name: init hidden
commands.description: Add combatant with hidden HP (shows status instead of numbers)

commands.name: init next
commands.description: Advance to next turn (auto-ticks status durations at round start)

commands.name: init damage
commands.description: Deal damage to a combatant

commands.name: init heal
commands.description: Heal a combatant

commands.name: init remove
commands.description: Remove combatant from initiative

commands.name: init clear
commands.description: End combat and clear initiative

commands.name: status
commands.description: View active status effects or condition details

commands.name: statusadd
commands.description: Apply status effect to combatant

commands.name: statusremove
commands.description: Remove status effect from combatant

commands.name: statustick
commands.description: Manually advance all status effect durations by 1 round

commands.name: statusclear
commands.description: Clear all status effects from all combatants

commands.name: conditions
commands.description: List all available D&D 5e conditions and custom effects

commands.name: break
commands.description: Insert a visual separator in chat

commands.name: ping
commands.description: Test bot connection

features: 🎲 Complete dice rolling system with modifiers (kh, kl, rr, combinations)
⚔️ Initiative tracker with hidden HP and automatic turn pinging
🎭 24 D&D 5e conditions with full descriptions and duration tracking
💾 Automatic persistence - combat state survives bot restarts
📝 Flexible command syntax - use !command or !command sub
🔄 Auto-tick status durations at round start
🔒 Hidden HP feature - automatically deletes command messages to keep HP secret

categories.name: Dice
categories.description: Comprehensive dice rolling with all modifiers
